column1: # Puerto Rico layouts, same format as layouts.tsv: id, country, language, kind, weight, template. The country is `US-PR`, which the
# renderer picks for Puerto Rico records only. The extra slot `urbanization` is the urbanization line (`URB` and its name).
# Layout sources: USPS Publication 28 section 292 and appendix I (the urbanization line sits above the delivery address line, and
# the last line is the city, `PR` and the ZIP Code); the comma and single-line forms are how addresses are written in running text.
